textRuns.value: Procore's trade vocabulary and the workbook's controlled keys are different vocabularies - Procore says "HVAC" and "Sprinkler" where the workbook says HVAC_DUCTWORK and FIRE_SPRINKLER. Unmatched rows are flagged, never dropped: in the workbook they would vanish from a lookup silently. Resolving them needs Affect to confirm the mapping, because guessing whether "Concrete Superstructure" is CIP concrete or slab on deck would attach a defect to the wrong trade.
